method: Point-in-time voice troubleshooting source pack built from delayed GSC rows, GA4 page-title and channel cards, current SERP/player questions, official CurseForge project pages, Groq documentation, Simple Voice Chat documentation, and public project metadata. This file does not collect API keys, upload audio, host Verity files, or claim that a voice symptom is a malware verdict.

currentProjectSignals.voiceEvidence: The source page says the pack supports voice chat, uses text-to-speech, supports direct chat, and that Groq issues are outside the pack author's control.

currentProjectSignals.route: Verity JE CurseForge standalone Java mod
currentProjectSignals.voiceEvidence: Use this as the standalone Java mod route; do not assume Simple Voice Chat or a modpack tutorial proves the standalone JAR voice path.
Local TTS is controlled by /verity:tts on and /verity:tts off; this is not the same as live Java microphone input.

currentProjectSignals.route: Smiley's Better Voice Verity JE voice add-on
currentProjectSignals.voiceEvidence: The project describes a Verity JE add-on for Fish Audio, Cartesia, expressive TTS, and voice mimicking. The current 4.0.0 file changelog says it supports Verity JE 6.0.0 and is incompatible with earlier Verity JE versions. Use it after the parent Verity JE route works; it is not a Bedrock route or a generic voice-fix mirror.

currentProjectSignals.route: Smiley OpenAL Android Java audio bridge
currentProjectSignals.voiceEvidence: The source page says it routes Verity microphone input and TTS through OpenAL for Android Java launchers and does not contain or redistribute Verity code.

providerAndVoiceSources.useFor: Separate microphone capture and speech-to-text from ordinary text-chat response failures. Groq documents audio transcription and translation endpoints plus supported Whisper models.
Separate TTS output, voice choice, input length, and response format from Verity Java download identity. Groq documents the audio/speech endpoint and Orpheus model IDs.
Separate generic voice-chat connection, microphone, speaker, UDP, proxy, and server-hosting checks from Verity-specific AI/provider behavior.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: Messages appear but no voice plays
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: TTS, output device, Minecraft audio, resource pack, or voice dependency
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Keep the current file installed, test one short text prompt, then check Minecraft/device output and route-specific TTS or voice dependencies.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not reinstall from mirrors when typed chat already works.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: Microphone works in Simple Voice Chat but Verity does not react
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: Verity talk control, STT route, provider response, or server-side dependency
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Prove typed Verity chat first, then test one short English voice phrase and server/client dependency parity.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not treat a generic voice-chat pass as proof that Verity received speech as a prompt.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: VERITY.exe does not talk or says API key problem
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: Modpack profile, Groq key, TTS tokens, provider quota, or voice-chat profile setup
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Open the current VERITY.exe project and file record, prove direct chat/text first, then debug Groq and voice chat separately.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not use unrelated EXE installers or replacement ZIPs as a voice fix.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: Smiley's Better Voice 4.0.0 is installed with an older Verity JE 5.x or earlier parent mod
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: Parent mod and add-on version mismatch
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Use Verity JE 6.0.0 for Better Voice 4.0.0, or intentionally choose an older Better Voice file that matches the older parent route.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not diagnose this first as a microphone, Fish Audio, Cartesia, or Groq key problem.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: Verity BE dialogue appears but audio is silent
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: Local TTS command, resource pack activation, device audio, or Bedrock world state
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Run /verity:tts on, activate the resource pack with the behavior pack, then test a clean Bedrock world.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not switch to a Java JAR for a Bedrock TTS issue.

diagnosisLayers.symptom: Android Java launcher says no compatible microphone
diagnosisLayers.likelyLayer: Android Java audio runtime or OpenAL bridge
diagnosisLayers.firstAction: Keep Verity JE installed, verify launcher microphone permission, and inspect the current Smiley OpenAL add-on route separately.
diagnosisLayers.avoid: Do not confuse Android Java launchers with MCPE Bedrock imports.
